budget_items.topic: Revenue: expected user charges and deduct meters
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Barb reported expected user charges and deduct meter revenue.
budget_items.quote: expected user charges are $1.2m. (927 users), deduct meters - $2,800 for 54 users,

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Connection fees were estimated assuming six new connections.
budget_items.quote: connection fees - $17k (assuming 6 new connections), sewer bank and drain layer fees.

budget_items.quote: she proposed charging $50 for internal traps and $100 for external interceptors if compliant.

budget_items.quote: sewer bank- $9,900 was collected last year and put in stabilization.

budget_items.quote: we are required to spend money every year on i/l remediation and for this budget we've estimated spending $10k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Three ARPA funding requests are shown in revenues and in capital expenditures and net to nothing ('a wash'); Barb will raise inclusion with the Town Manager.
budget_items.quote: the 3 arpa funding requests that are included in revenues are spent in capital expenditures, so they are 'a wash'.
